title: Common feed options
description: Runtime options every driver accepts alongside its own configuration.

staleWarnSec.title: Stale warning (s)
staleWarnSec.description: Health turns to warn when no report has arrived for this long.

staleCriticalSec.title: Stale critical (s)
staleCriticalSec.description: Health turns to critical when no report has arrived for this long.

pinnedReplica.title: Pinned replica
pinnedReplica.description: Run this feed only on the named ingest replica (required for listening transports).

classification.title: Classification
classification.description: Stamped on every observation this feed emits unless the decoder reports a higher level. Entities keep the highest level any feed reported.
